questions.q: If $2 \tan ^{-1}(\cos x)=\tan ^{-1}(2 \operatorname{cosec} x)$, then the value of $x$ is
questions.solution:
$\begin{aligned}$& 2 \tan ^{-1}(\cos x)=\tan ^{-1}(2 \operatorname{cosec} x) \\
\Rightarrow & \tan ^{-1}$\left(\frac{2 \cos x}{1-\cos ^{2} x}\right)=\tan ^{-1}($2 \operatorname{cosec} x) \\
\Rightarrow & $\frac{2 \cos x}{1-\cos ^{2} x}=$2 \operatorname{cosec} x \\
\Rightarrow & $\frac{2 \cos x}{\sin ^{2} x}=$2 \operatorname{cosec} x \\
\Rightarrow & \sin x=\cos x \Rightarrow x=$\frac{\pi}{4}
\end{aligned}$

questions.q: $The equation of a directrix of the ellipse \frac{x^{2}}{16}+\frac{y^{2}}{25}=1$ is
questions.solution: Equation of ellipse $\frac{\mathrmx^{2}}{\mathrm{ b}^{2}}+\frac{\mathrmy^{2}}{\mathrma^{2}}=1$, where $a > b$. Given, $\frac{x^{2}}{16}+\frac{y^{2}}{75}=1 \Rightarrow b=4, a=5$ But $\mathrm{e}=\sqrt{1-\frac{\mathrmb^{2}}{\mathrma^{2}}}=\sqrt{1-\frac{16}{25}}\Rightarrow \mathrm{e}=\frac{3}{5}\therefore$ equation of directrix $\mathrm{y}=\pm \frac{\mathrm{a}}{\mathrm{e}}\therefore \quad y=\pm \frac{5}{3 / 5} \Rightarrow 3 y=\pm 25$

questions.q: If $X$ is a poisson variate such that $2 \mathrm{P}(\mathrm{X}=0)+\mathrm{P}(\mathrm{X}=2)=2 \mathrm{P}(\mathrm{X}=1)$ then $\mathrm{E}(\mathrm{X})$ is equal to
questions.solution:
If $2 \mathrm{P}(\mathrm{X}=0)+\mathrm{P}(\mathrm{X}=2)=2 \mathrm{P}(\mathrm{X}=1)$
Let probability distribution of $X$ be given by
$\begin{array}{l}
\mathrm{P}(\mathrm{X}=\mathrm{r})=\frac{\mathrm{m}^{\mathrm{r}} \cdot \mathrm{e}^{-\mathrm{m}}}{\mathrm{r} !} \text{ where } \mathrm{r}=0,1,2, \ldots \ldots \\
\therefore 2\left[\frac{\mathrm{m}^{0} \mathrm{e}^{-\mathrm{m}}}{0 !}\right]+\left[\frac{\mathrm{m}^{2} \cdot \mathrm{e}^{-\mathrm{m}}}{2 !}\right]=2\left[\frac{\mathrm{m} \cdot \mathrm{e}^{-\mathrm{m}}}{1 !}\right] \\
\Rightarrow 2+\frac{\mathrm{m}^{2}}{2}=2 \mathrm{ m} \Rightarrow \mathrm{m}^{2}-4 \mathrm{ m}+4=0 \\
\Rightarrow(\mathrm{m}-2)^{2}=0 \Rightarrow \mathrm{m}=2
\end{array}$
